$comment: Copy to config.json and fill in your own device. config.json is gitignored.

device.name: My HyperCube
device.$comment: model: auto | nano | hc10-se | hc15-se. auto asks the cube and matches it against src/models.mjs; set it by hand if that guesses wrong.

transport.$comment: Measured on a HyperCube Nano (hs-2.0): DDP and Art-Net ports are closed; WLED DRGB and sACN universe 1 both work. Run scripts/blink.mjs to probe your own device.

leds.$comment: Optional overrides; anything set here beats the model table and the cube's own report. The Nano reports 88 addresses but only the first 44 drive anything, so on a cube nobody has probed yet run scripts/diagnose.mjs and set working to what you find. count: addresses the controller reports. working: addresses that drive an LED. perEdge: LEDs per edge. blocks: edges driven by each address block, e.g. [1, 2, 4, 5].
